description: Locate. Call this when you hold a barcode and need to know where the product is sold. Returns the retail banners and the markets where the barcode is on the record as sold, each with the source page it was read on (where the record holds one) and the date it was read, and each banner's page on identifyfetch.ai. Never price, never stock: for those, ask the retailer. An empty list means the record holds no place of sale, not that the product is not sold. Read from the same signed record as fetch_gtin.

market.description: optional market code, e.g. UK, US, FR: used for the recall check and to tag the ask

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/

name: locate
title: Locate: where a barcode is sold
